name: Better Paseo Antigravity
description: Stability-first Antigravity CLI (agy acp) provider: optional SSE stall auto-recovery (off by default, configurable timeout and retries in plugin settings), background-task protection, reliable cleanup, history replay and diagnostics.

zh-CN.name: Better Paseo Antigravity
zh-CN.description: 专注长会话稳定性的 Antigravity CLI（agy acp）Provider：可选 SSE 静默自动恢复（默认关闭，可在插件设置页开启并自定义检测时间与重试次数），保护后台任务，保留可靠清理、休眠重算、历史回放与真实诊断。
